name: Conundrum Ward AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: A complex geometrical ward with mathematical equations woven into its lines magically seals the door, harming anyone who touches it.
disable: DC 30 Thievery (master) to sabotage the ward, Geometry or Mathematics Lore (trained) to calculate the solution to the complex equations, DC 28 Crafting (expert) to manipulate the ward's precise underlying schematics, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the magical ward
reset: The trap automatically resets after being triggered. If disabled, the ward does not reset.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mental Conundrum
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the door directly or with a tool

Effect The ward's equations spiral and swirl, drawing the mind into an inescapable conundrum. The triggering creature is dealt (4d10+26) Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 32 Will Saving Throw save). On a failure, the target is additionally Stupefied 2, or Stupefied 4 on a critical failure.
